checked.claim: No GDPR fines on Art. 83(7) bodies (s. 62); ÚOOÚ has however fined a public body (Arbitration Court) for obstruction
checked.evidence: s. 62(5): 'The Office shall waive administrative punishment also with respect to controllers and processors set out in Art. 83(7)'. The second sentence overreaches: the Arbitration Court attached to the Economic Chamber is a permanent arbitration court, not obviously a public authority, and the fine was a procedural fine in an FOI appeal, not a data protection penalty. It should not be presented as an exception to s. 62.
checked.replacement: No. The Office must refrain from imposing administrative penalties on the entities listed in Art. 83(7) GDPR, i.e. public authorities and bodies (s. 62(5) Act 110/2019). Corrective orders still apply. Separately, ÚOOÚ can impose procedural fines for non-cooperation in proceedings it handles: a CZK 30,000 fine on the Arbitration Court of the Economic Chamber in a freedom of information appeal was upheld by the Municipal Court in Prague on 29 July 2026.
